name: TREAT M2/M3 Transient Benchmark
description: A benchmark evaluation using experimental transient data from the TREAT reactor M2 and M3 experiments to assess simulation/model fidelity for reactor transients.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific experimental benchmark used within reactor engineering and validation communities rather than broad ML benchmarking.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark using experimental transient reactor data; small and domain-specific dataset(s) with limited generalizability outside nuclear engineering; intended for simulation/model fidelity evaluation.
